n.story:

In the past, much of your week was consumed by the 'paperwork' of compassion—manually tracking budgets, building staff rotas, and maintaining meticulous service user records. AI now handles these data-heavy tasks with near-perfect accuracy, instantly generating compliant documentation from your spoken notes and optimizing complex shift patterns that account for both labor laws and employee preferences.
